Hi Mateo,

We have a coordinated feature launch on 2026-10-08 and the traffic forecasts attached show a short window spike (30–45 minutes) that will exceed our current quota by ~4x. We want to avoid customer-visible throttling. Two quick questions:

1) Do you offer an automatic temporary quota bump (auto-scale) that kicks in during short spikes? If so, what is the billing model for auto-scale vs a one-off temporary top-up?
2) If we opt for a standard overrun true-up, what's your recommended cadence and is there any discount for the first incident (we're a mid-stage customer and this is our first major launch)?

Attached: traffic-forecast.csv — small window, high QPS.

— Ops Team

Subject: Re: Upcoming launch — avoiding throttles / overrun handling

Hi Ops,

Thanks for the forecast — looks like a classic short-window burst. We have two operational paths:

Option A — Temporary top-up (recommended for short predictable spikes)
- We provision a fixed temporary quota for the launch window (you pick size and duration).
- Billing: one-time prorated fee based on peak token throughput + a small setup charge.
- Pro: predictable invoice, no runtime throttling.
- Con: you pay for reserved headroom you may not fully use.

Option B — Auto-scale (pay-as-you-go burst)
- Our runtime will automatically accept excess traffic and bill overrun at the overage rate.
- Billing: standard overrun rates (listed below) billed in the next invoice period.
- Pro: no manual provisioning.
- Con: less predictable spend, higher per-unit price vs committed capacity.

Proposal (fast path to reduce risk):
- We can enable a temporary top-up for the launch window (10/08 00:00 — 10/08 06:00 UTC) sized for ~5x baseline to cover your forecast.
- As a one-time launch goodwill, Redwood can apply a 15% credit against the overrun/top-up fee for this first incident if you sign the attached short addendum and commit to issuing PO within 7 days.

Next steps:
1) If you want the temporary top-up, confirm size (we can match the attached forecast).
2) If you prefer auto-scale, confirm you accept the standard overrun billing and we'll turn on the policy; we'll also send a post-launch true-up one pager.
3) If approved, I can send a draft addendum (attaching a short proposal now).

I copied Ben (pricing) and Monica (billing) on logistics. Happy to hop on a 30-min call today or tomorrow.

Thanks,
Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
